name: VideoGen
long_description:
VideoGen makes it easy for anyone to create professional, copyright-free videos in seconds. Our AI video generator turns a prompt, script, or article into a finished video, complete with AI voiceover, subtitles, and b-roll, powered by the latest models like Sora, Veo, and Kling. Today, over 5 million users trust VideoGen, from individuals and small businesses to teams at Google and ByteDance.

Making videos is hard, time-consuming, and expensive if you hire someone to do it for you. With VideoGen, it only takes a few clicks! Try it at https://videogen.io/, or build video into your own product with our API: https://videogen.io/videogen-api
one_liner: Create professional videos in minutes with AI, online or via API

launches.title: VideoGen – Generate professional videos in seconds
launches.tagline: Introducing VideoGen, the world's first AI that can create and edit videos for you.
launches.body:
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=unJnvJqdN28>

**TLDR:** [VideoGen](https://videogen.io) makes it easy for anyone to create professional, copyright-free videos in seconds. Today, we serve thousands of customers, from individuals and small businesses to teams at Google and ByteDance. Making videos is hard, time-consuming, and expensive when outsourced. With VideoGen, it only takes a few clicks!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83780&key=user_uploads/1009656/0cd0d883-05cf-413b-b11b-aca79175e512)

👋 Hello, we’re Anton and David. We bootstrapped VideoGen out of our college dorm rooms to over 1 million users in under a year. We met at a tennis academy in middle school and became friends through our shared passion for building web apps and playing tennis. Now, we’re changing how the world creates videos with the help of AI.

### **The Problem: Creating videos is tedious, painful, and hard.**

Making videos is hard. Each step of the process—scripting, recording voice-overs, finding and licensing high-quality footage, and editing—is extremely time-consuming.

Video editing products today are hard to use and have too many buttons. Paying someone to make videos for you is expensive and slow.

### **The Solution: AI that creates videos for you.**

VideoGen can automatically edit professional videos together in a few seconds, saving our customers time and the pain of hiring a video editor.

In just a few clicks, VideoGen can:

​​🧠 Take in company/brand knowledge and media

​​✍️ Write a video script

🗣️ Generate a lifelike voice-over

✂️ Edit together relevant, copyright-free footage

💬 Add captions

VideoGen does this all in over 100 languages and accents for a global user base.

Once your video is done, you can add your finishing touches in an easy-to-use, web-based video editor.

### **Try the API – Get $1,000 in free credits (YC Deal)**

Are you interested in integrating VideoGen with your app? Reach out to us at [founders@videogen.io](mailto:founders@videogen.io)
